answers.core: This is a QoL enhancement for all `AnimatedSprite2D` usage.
answers.workaround:
Unless something like #8698 is implemented, I don't think this is possible with GDScript.

Perhaps you could do something with a plugin's `_forward_canvas_gui_input` though I'm not sure. Even then, `Texture2D.is_pixel_opaque` isn't available to scripts (for whatever reason), so you'd have to come up with some kind of workaround for that.

title: Make AnimatedSprite2D selection in the editor behave the same as Sprite2D (select based on texture opacity)
